title: I tracked 847 inputs for 14 days. Here's my attention gravity system.
content:
I've always wondered: where does my attention actually go?

So I built an attention gravity system. Every email, message, meeting, and notification gets scored before it reaches me.

**The Math:**
- Impact (1-10): How much this affects my 90-day goals
- Urgency (1-10): Time sensitivity
- Gravity = Impact² + (Urgency × 1.5)

**14 days of data:**
- 847 total inputs evaluated
- 312 auto-rejected (gravity < 15)
- 89 scheduled for later
- Only 23 reached me in real-time

The most surprising finding? 67% of what I thought was 'urgent' had gravity < 20.

One example: A competitor launched a new feature. My team flagged it immediately. Gravity score: 18 (scheduled for Friday review). The sky didn't fall.

**Week 2 experiment:** I added 'strategic depth' weighting for long-term plays.

What's your gravity threshold?
